description: Token-for-token escrow on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.30). Sol.College runs this lab on its own fork to demonstrate the research, validation, adoption and acceptance pipeline.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration on the Blockchains/gifter-escrow fork. The upstream author (berkaycirak) has not joined Sol.College; fixes are offered upstream as ordinary pull requests and acceptance here is by Sol.College's own reviewer, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness on the Solana runtime (create_escrow, take_and_close, refund)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet app at sol.college/dapps/gifter-escrow/
QA: localnet integration fixtures and negative cases
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Escrow list does not refresh after creating, taking or cancelling an escrow
Extend the localnet fixture with refund negative cases
